title: File explorer when creating a new script is extremely slow on Linux
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.3.stable.mono, 4.5.beta4.mono

### System information

Godot v4.5.beta4.mono - Fedora Linux 42 (Workstation Edition) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6900 XT (RADV NAVI21) - AMD Ryzen 9 5950X 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 62.68 GiB memory

### Issue description

When creating a new script and attaching it to a node, the file explorer is extremely slow for both C# and GDscript.  

This only happens specifically when creating a new script, so in situations like for example saving a branch node as a new scene, this does not happen.

Video demonstration:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d756ab59-7e64-4b76-bd56-869bbb9da149

Here is when saving a regular node as a scene for example to show that its exclusively for scripts that this issue occurs:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9eedbd50-344d-4d82-b710-644b35a3a140

Here is another demonstration for creating a script but not attaching it to a node, but rather creating in the filesystem view and also comparing it to other resource types:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e49416c8-5fb4-4d42-a319-08aab8657fbc

### Steps to reproduce

1) Create a new scene or a new node in an existing scene
2) Attach a new script
3) Click browse files
4) Witness slow file explorer

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Reproducible regardless of project
